subject: MAP kickoff: Solara Health — draft & timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: Solara Health — draft & timeline

Hi Sofia (and team),

Thanks again for the discovery conversation earlier — really helpful context on Solara's ingestion volume, security reqs, and procurement timeline. As discussed, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align milestones, ownership, and target close dates so we can move this forward predictably. Attached: Solara_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx and the Redwood_MAP_Template.docx for reference.

High-level proposed milestones (draft):
- 1) Technical kickoff & architecture review — Redwood / Solara (Milestone owner: Aditya) — target: Week 1 after MAP sign-off
- 2) Security & compliance review (SOC 2 evidence + data flow) — Solara SecOps / Redwood Security — target: Week 2
- 3) Pilot integration (private VPC) & performance baseline — Solara devs / Redwood eng — target: Weeks 3-4
- 4) Commercial review & procurement (PO/SOW) — Solara procurement / Redwood sales — target: Week 4-6
- 5) Production rollout / go-live — joint — target: Week 6-8

Dependencies we flagged on the call:
- Solara to provide architecture diagram and an initial dataflow doc (needed for security scoping)
- Export controls & KMS details to validate encryption options
- Procurement window: when can Solara sign an SOW/PO?

Timeline options (pick one):
- Option A: Accelerated — 6 weeks from MAP sign-off (target close ~Dec 31) — requires 2x SRE support during pilot and expedited security review
- Option B: Standard — 8 weeks from MAP sign-off (target close ~Jan 14) — aligns with typical procurement cadence
- Option C: Extended — 12 weeks (target close ~Feb 11) — if security / legal need more time

Ask: can you confirm the Solara MAP owner (single point of contact for trackers), the core stakeholders who should be listed on the MAP (technical, security, procurement), and which timeline option you prefer? If helpful I can also schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff next week to walk through the doc and surface any blockers.

Next steps from my side: I’ll incorporate your stakeholder list into the MAP and update milestones + target dates once you pick a timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Solara_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Redwood_MAP_Template.docx (template)

Can you update the MAP with the stakeholder list and Option B target dates? Also please add a placeholder for the procurement PO/SOW and the DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks — Sofia
